Dry Sack Sherry, Williams & Humbert of London- "The Sherry in a Sack" is one of the world's classic  Sherries- neither too dry or sweet; a medium Sherry, full bodied and soft iwth a delicate nutty flavor- especially delightful when served "on the rocks".
Canasta Cream Sherry, Williams & Humbert of London- For who prefer sweet Sherry. Canasata Cream has a soft rich taste. It is a fine, rich Oloroso, which is equal to any cream Sherry on the market.
Victoria Fino Sherry, Bobadilla & Company- A light, dry, Fino Sherry specially blended to suit American taste. The perfect apertif made from Bobadilla's vast stock of Sherries.
Amontillado Sherry, Bobadilla & Company- A superior, pale Sherry with excellent Amontillado characteristics. Dry, yet not as dry as a Fino.
SANDEMAN COCKTAIL SHERRY, W.A. Taylor & Company- A Light Amontillado, pleasantly dry, mellow and smooth. Excellent chilled.May be kept in the refrigerator. Makes the smoothest and driest Martini.
THREE STAR AMONTILLADO SHERRY- W. A. Taylor & Company- A Medium Dry Amontillado with a pleasing "roundness". Suitable for most occasions- imparts the "gourmet touch" to cooked dishes.
SANDEMAN CREAM SHERRY- W.A.Taylor & Company-A Rich CreamSherry for those who appreciate a genuine imported Cream Sherry- and at a most reasonable price.
Heublein, Inc., present Harvey's Imported Sherries- Harvey's of bristol has been shipping Sherry from Spain for 170 ears. These wines are of the hoghest quality. The finest Sherry to be bought.
HARVEY'S BRISTOL FINO SHERRY- Heublein, Inc.- The classic dry Sherry of the Fino range, this fine wine is distinguished by a remarkable bouquet of the "flor" and a clean finish. It is best chilled as an aperitif or with fish.
HARVEY'S SHOOTING SHERRY- Heublein, Inc.- Here is a medium Oloroso. full-bodied but not too full, subtly sweet, suitable for all occasions. It is best served chilled before or after the meal.
TIO PEPE SHERRY- Schieffelin & Co.-  Literally translated "Uncle Joe" is named after one of the older members of the Gonzalez family, whose favorite it was. Tio Pepe is considered the ultimate in Dry Sherry, being extremely dry and delicate. It is the standard by which all Dry Sherries ave been judged throughout the world for generations. Today, Gonzalez, Byass is known the world over as one of Spain's finest Sherries. Gonzales, Byass are the largest vineyard owners in Jerez, with over 1,000 acres of the finest Sherry producing vineyards. A minimum of 30,000 butts of selected Sherry is kept maturing in the Soleras of the firm's bodegas or warehouses. The company is 130 years old, having been founded by Don Manuel and Maria Gonzales.
California Sherries and Dessert Wines- BV California Sherries and Dessert wines are long matured in small oak casks to slowly gain age and character until they attain true Beaulieu Quality.
BV Pale Dry Sherry, Beaulieu Vineyard- Light  and dry; a fine cocktail sherry with the crisp, delicate taste reminiscent of a fine Spanish Fino.
BV Sherry, Beaulieu Vineyard- Richer in color and body; a choice aperitif wine, pleasingly smooth and mellow....medium dry.
BV Cream Sherry, Beaulieu Vineyard- Golden amber, with the full richness of a Spanish Oloroso.  A sherry to savor slowly and thoughtfully.
"21" Brands, Inc., present Louis M. Martini, St. Helena, Napa County, California
Pale Dry Sherry, Louis M. Martini- A very pale dry Sherry with a distinctive nutty flavor acquired from long and careful aging in small cooperage according to the "Solero" System.
California Cream Sherry, Louis M. Martini- After many years of aging, Louis Martini is proud to present this very fine smooth, sweet Sherry comparable to the best Spanish Oloroso.
'21" Brands, Inc., present Louis M. Martini (St. Helena, Napa County, California)
California Port, Louis M. Martini- From a special limited supply of superior aged Ports comes this blend of very fine deep ruby colored wine with a soft, delicate flavor.
Beaulieu Vineyard, BV, Napa Valley , California, present
BV Port, Beaulieu Vineyard- Rich, ruby red, with a lovely warmth and fragrance, fine bouquet, and soft, well-matured flavor.
"21" Brands, Inc., present S.V.P. Constantino, Porto, Portugal
S.V.P. Constantino Fine Ruby Port- From the Constantina cellars, founded in 1877, comes this Port of delicate taste and medium body.
S.V.P. Constantino 3 Crown Tawny Port- Distinguished and well aged, a pleasantly sweet wine.
Heublein, Inc., present Harvey's Imported Port
The superb quality of Harvey's Ports reflects centurie sof experience as shippers of Port wine. Two main styles are available in the United States, Ruby and Tawny. Port is matured in wood in Portugal. Gold Cap Ruby is young, fruity and full-bodied while  the Tawnies are paler from long years in the cask and have a fine nutty flavor and dry finish.
HARVEY'S HUNTING PORT- An old fine soft Tawny Port with a remarkably subtle flavor especially appreciated by connoisseurs. Equally suitable before or after a meal. Hunting Port is a traditional bracer for outdoor's men.
Julius Wile Sons and Co., present Robertson Brothers
One of the most highly regardedvoneyard owners is the firm of Robertson Brothers. This firm, established in 1805, owns two of the most famous vineyards in Portugal's noted Douro Valley.
Dry Humour Port, Robertson Brothers- A superior quality dry Tawny Port, dark in color with a rich mellow fruitness.
No. 1 Game Bird Port, Robertson Brothers- A fine, dry Tawny Port, light and delicious- and for its quality,very inexpensive.
Julius Wile sons and Co., present
Leacock & Company- This firm is one of the oldest shippers of Madeira- their history goes bavk to 1741. They are extensive vineyard owners and the company is still run by members of the original Leacock family.
Leacock Madeira- A cocktail Madeira- pleasantly dry with depth of flavor- ideally suited for the American taste- an all purpose Madeira.

Wines- The wines chosen by British Airways' panel of experts for service on today's flight feature especially some from California. Although the wine industry is still, relatively, in its infancy, many of the wines of the West Coast can bear comparison with the best of Europe. Using European grape varieties and New World innovative technology, the white wines are crisp and fresh while the red wines are powerful and complex.
Deidesheimer Hofstuck Kabinett 1989- Coming from the more southernly Rheinplaz region of Germany, this wine has more weight and pungency than normal, yet remains light in alcohol. It is medium dry with open, grapey aromas and well balanced acidity, and it has a crisp freshness that enlivens the palate.
Lanson Black Label Champagne- This champagne is very fresh and fragrant, with a lovely bite of acidity that cleans and refreshes your palate. It is blended from black and white grapes from some of the best vineyard sites, then aged for at least 3 years in Lanson's underground cellars at a constant cool temperature. Very appealing and delicious with food.
Fleurie, 1989- Fleurie is the gentler, more elegant feminine side of Beaujolais. It has a powerful bouquet and it has the ripeness of fruit, but it has a wonderfully soft texture, smooth and light on the palate with tingly acidity that leaves you refreshed.
Chablis, 1988 Laboure-Roi- 1988 was a difficult vintage for Chablis with a hard winter followed by severe spring frosts. Despite this, the vines flowered on time, and the mid-Summer period, right up to the harvest, had plentiful sunshine. The wines are ripe with the characteristic acidic balance of Chablis, very fresh, lively and appealing.
J. Lohr Riverstone Chardonnay 1989- This deliciously typical Californian Chardonnay is rich in fruit and has a powerful oaky intensity.  Yet coming from cool Monterrey County, it also has finesse and elegance. Harnessing the natural benefits of California's climate to modern vinification techniques and adding 100% barrel fermentation, has produced a superb wine.
